mintAuthority.summary: bbqUSDC is an immutable MetaMorpho ERC-4626 vault (no EIP-1967 proxy slots); shares are minted only against USDC deposits. Vault owner is the Steakhouse Safe v1.4.1 8/5. Base USDC issuance is inherited from Circle.

controls.label: Smokehouse USDC MetaMorpho vault (immutable, deposit-only mint)
controls.capDescription: Vault shares are minted only against deposited USDC. No EIP-1967 proxy admin or implementation slot was found; the owner can manage Morpho vault parameters but cannot mint unbacked base USDC.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, asset() returned USDC (0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48), owner() returned Steakhouse Safe 0x0a0e559b..., and the EIP-1967 implementation, proxy-admin, and beacon slots were all zero. The direct MetaMorpho code therefore has no implementation-replacement path.

controls.label: Inherited Ethereum USDC MasterMinter
controls.evidence: Inherited from reviewed usdc-circle parent; base USDC issuance is Circle-controlled.

review.evidence: RPC and explorer review confirmed an immutable MetaMorpho vault over USDC, deposit-only wrapper minting, and Steakhouse Safe ownership (8 owners, threshold 5, no modules returned). Durable base-asset mint authority remains with Circle USDC. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: the immutable MetaMorpho wrapper mints shares only against deposited USDC; base issuance inherits Circle's monthly Deloitte reserve examination. The latest available USDC report covers May 2026, and the NYDFS virtual-currency list matches Circle Internet Financial, LLC. M-2 evidence review 2026-08-08: supervision and reconciliation downgraded to the wrapper-level convention (steakusdc precedent) - the coin's issuer of record is the vault curator, which no named prudential regime supervises (jurisdiction is correspondingly empty), and the deposit-only share wrapper is not a separate issuer reserve regime. Circle's NYDFS supervision and monthly Deloitte examinations are facts of the underlying USDC, credited on usdc-circle, not of this wrapper. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the immutable vault mints shares only against deposited USDC, with no local attestation or prudential regime.
